47: What is different about Torah scholars? - This is an answer. This is what [the gemara] is saying: in fact his warning is considered retracted, and this evidenced from the mishna. Why do we specifically require Torah scholars? Because they are learned -- [since] she is forbidden to him if he has not retracted his warning, if he happens to [desire to] engage in sexual intercourse, they will tell him "retract your warning."
